Generated by tools/figures/architecture_readme.py from architecture/item-definition.yaml, safety/hazards/ and requirements/. Concept-stage item definition (status

g.text: Terms: CONOPS = concept of operations · ESC = electronic speed controller (drives a UAV motor) · F-nnn = system function in the item definition ·
MOD-nnn = operating mode from the CONOPS (MOD-01 to MOD-10) · PX4 = PX4 Autopilot, the open-source flight-control software candidate for SUS-A1 ·
SCN-nnn = CONOPS scenario (SCN-0nn nominal, SCN-1nn off-nominal) · SUS-A1 = dockable observation UAV · SUS-A1-FC = PX4-based flight controller ·
SUS-A1-NAV = navigation sensors, camera and telemetry · SUS-A1-PROP = motors, ESCs and propellers · SUS-A1-PWR = UAV battery and power management
· SUS-GSE = ground support, maintenance supports, charging and test equipment · SUS-I1-INT = integration manager and PX4 command adapter ·
SUS-M1-CTL = mission, motion and balance control · SUS-M1-DCK = UAV dock, retention, charging and release · SUS-M1-MAN = manipulation arms and
end effectors · SUS-M1-PIL = pilot station, restraints, displays and controls · SUS-M1-PWR = power generation, storage, distribution and thermal
control · SUS-M1-SAF = independent safety monitor, protective stop and isolation · SUS-M1-WLK = chassis, legs, joint actuators and stability
